items.q: How does Pixelify process images without uploading to cloud servers?
items.a: The AI runs right in your browser using WebGPU and ONNX Runtime, so your images stay on your device—not on someone else’s server.

items.q: Is Pixelify really 100% free with no watermarks or subscriptions?
items.a: Yes—no subscriptions, credits, watermarks, or surprise paywalls; just upload, edit, and download.

items.q: What is the maximum resolution and image size I can upscale?
items.a: Upscale images up to 40 MB and 16K resolution (16,384 × 16,384 px)—your device’s memory is the only real boss here.

items.q: Can I use Pixelify offline without an active internet connection?
items.a: Once the AI models are cached, you can process images offline—perfect for flights, commutes, or Wi-Fi that decided to take a day off.

items.q: How does Chopper compare to standard background removers?
items.a: Chopper is designed to preserve tricky details like hair, fur, and fine edges, so your subject doesn’t end up looking like it lost a fight with scissors.

items.q: Does Pixelify work on mobile phones and tablets?
items.a: Yes! Pixelify works on supported mobile browsers too, using WebGPU or a compatible WASM fallback when available.

items.q: Are my private photos and client confidential assets safe?
items.a: Your images stay on your device during processing; even our site-visit counter has no business knowing what you’re editing.

items.q: How do I clear downloaded models if I need to free up browser storage?
items.a: Open Settings and select “Clear downloaded models”—a quick cleanup without having to clear your entire browser cache.

upscaleJourney.title: How It Works

upscaleJourney.step2Desc: Vitality for instant passes, or Pixel-Dance & Alpha-Satoru for maximum fidelity, then dial in denoise, sharpen and HDR per image.
upscaleJourney.step3Desc: Tiles stream through the GPU with live progress. Your photo never touches a server, the network runs in this tab.
upscaleJourney.step4Desc: Download full-resolution PNG or WebP files without watermarks, compression artifacts, or forced sign-ups.

items.q: How does Pixelify upscale to 8K like resolution?
items.a: A neural super-resolution network reconstructs your image tile by tile, directly on your GPU. Each pass adds real detail, edges, texture, faces, so a small photo comes out crisp at up to 16,384 × 16,384 pixels. 8K output is one tap, not a render farm.

items.q: Is my image uploaded to a cloud server?
items.a: Never. The model runs inside your browser tab via WebGPU / WebAssembly. Your photo is processed on your own silicon and stays on your device. There is no queue, no bucket, and no one watching.

items.q: Do I need an account or credits?
items.a: No sign-up, no email, no credit system. Open the page, drop an image, and upscale as many files as you want. Unlimited runs, forever free.

items.q: What can I export, and is there a watermark?
items.a: Lossless PNG or WebP at the full upscaled resolution. No watermark, no quality cap, no daily limit. What you see in the preview is exactly what you download.

items.q: Will it work on my laptop or phone?
items.a: Yes. On devices with WebGPU you get hardware acceleration. Everywhere else the engine falls back to WebAssembly automatically, so the studio works in any modern browser.

The Turbo engine finishes most images in under a second on a mid-range GPU. The studio-grade Alpha-Satoru pass takes a few seconds for maximum fidelity. Both run locally, so speed depends on your hardware, not a server queue.

faqItems.q: How do I remove a background for free?
faqItems.a: Open the Background Remover, drag your image into the upload area, and the AI cutout starts automatically. When it finishes, download the transparent PNG, no sign-up, no credits, no watermark.

faqItems.q: What is the Diablo model and how does it differ from Chopper?
faqItems.a: Chopper is our ultra-fast default model optimized for rapid cutouts across all devices. Diablo is our premium high-precision neural model powered by a 1024×1024 input tensor and advanced edge matting, engineered specifically to preserve fine flyaway hair, pet fur, transparent glass, and intricate edges with zero halo artifacts.

faqItems.q: When should I use Diablo instead of Chopper?
faqItems.a: Chopper is ideal for everyday e-commerce product photos, logos, and general cutouts where speed is paramount. Use Diablo when maximum detail is needed: studio portraits with complex hair, furry animals, semi-transparent fabrics, jewelry, or high-resolution marketing assets.

faqItems.q: How do I activate the Diablo Ultra Precision model?
faqItems.a: Once your cutout is generated, you will see a 'Refine with Diablo Ultra Precision' option right inside the Cutout tools sidebar. Clicking it instantly switches to Diablo's high-definition matting pipeline. You can also re-process any image with Diablo whenever you need the highest fidelity.

faqItems.q: Does Diablo run locally and work offline?
faqItems.a: Yes. Both Chopper and Diablo execute 100% on your device using WebGPU with automatic multi-threaded WebAssembly fallback. Once Diablo's neural weights are downloaded to your browser's local cache on first use, it runs completely offline without sending your photos to any cloud server.

faqItems.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faqItems.a: No. The AI models run directly inside your browser through WebGPU or WebAssembly. Your photos never leave your device, which makes Pixelify completely safe for private, confidential, or client work.

faqItems.q: Which formats can I use and export?
faqItems.a: Upload PNG, JPG, and WebP up to 20 MB. Export as transparent PNG for cutouts, WebP for the web with alpha kept, or JPG flattened onto a solid background.

faqItems.q: Can I replace the removed background?
faqItems.a: Yes. Once the cutout is done, open the Background tab to place your subject on a transparent canvas, a solid or gradient color, or your own uploaded photo, then download the composite in one click.

faqItems.q: Does it handle hair, fur and glass?
faqItems.a: The bilateral-reference architecture is trained specifically on fine boundaries. For standard photos, Chopper preserves edges cleanly; for intricate hair strands, wisps, and fur, the Diablo Ultra Precision model delivers studio-grade alpha transparency.

faqItems.q: Why is the first image slower?
faqItems.a: The neural model downloads to your browser cache on first use. Every image after that reuses the cached weights instantly, so processing drops to just a few seconds on most hardware.
